candidates.statement: It should be noted that Dyson obtained this result using one of the early results of Widom [@33] on the asymptotics of Toeplitz determinants with symbols supported on circular arcs.

[^4]: It should be noted that the Hastings-McLeod solution is very unstable; indeed, a small change in the pre-exponential numerical factor in the normalization condition ([\[painleve2\]](#painleve2){reference-type="ref" reference="painleve2"}) yields a completely different type of behavior of $u(x)$ for negative $x$, including the appearance of singularities (e.g. see again [@FIKN] ).

It should be noted that the authors of [@DeiGio1; @DeiGio2] based their analysis on Widom's papers [@95; @96] where important relations between symplectic, orthogonal and unitary ensembles were established for finite $N$.
